text: Swimming is an exciting and enjoyable sport that requires a lot of skill and practice. One of the most important aspects of swimming is lap swimming, where you swim back and forth across the water. It's a great way to improve your endurance and build up your strength. However, it's easy to get overwhelmed with the number of laps you do, especially if you're new to swimming. Using goggles while swimming can actually help reduce the pressure on your eyes, which can cause discomfort. They provide a clear, unobstructed view of the water, making it easier to maintain proper technique. Additionally, goggles can improve your visibility, especially in low-light conditions, and they also offer a great way to keep your ears open.
